2.en:
Situation report — last 2 hours

  • STRIKE: Israeli UAV struck a Hamas police point near Masjid Muawiya, NW Rafah. Report: 2 killed, several wounded.
  • Northern/Southern Lebanon: IDF 300th Brigade operating in the Security Zone near Majdal Zoun. IDF reports dismantling a ~35m underground tunnel containing two Hezbollah living quarters. Operations to remove threats continue.
  • Gaza: 70 bodies recovered from rubble. Mass funeral reported in Gaza. Hamas reports 1,647 dead and 5,969 wounded since the Oct 2025 ceasefire.
  • Maritime / Persian Gulf: UKMTO issued a warning after a reported attack on a tanker eastbound through the Persian Gulf toward the Strait of Hormuz. IRGC (TASS) reports a supertanker sank in the Persian Gulf.
  • Iranian airspace / air defenses: Surface-to-air missile launched from Qeshm. Iranian air defenses reported dealing with enemy surveillance drones.
  • Yemen: Houthis pushing south in Lahij governorate, reported aim to encircle PLC units west of their advance; forces crossed the al-Sarih junction.
  • Intelligence / Claims: Times of Israel cites NYT reporting that Israel kidnapped Iranian generals and killed one while searching for Ron Arad (reported claim).
  • Diplomatic / Alliance moves: NATO canceled its planned 2027 leaders' summit in Albania and is reducing high-level meetings (reported).
  • Other: Iran says it hopes to commission its first fusion facility (AEOI chief, TASS). Iran in close contact with Russia and China (TASS). Israeli civilian who crossed by sea into Jordanian waters was detained by Jordanian security forces (IDF report).
  • Threat trend: Heightened regional kinetic activity across maritime routes, Iranian airspace, Gaza and southern Lebanon in the last two hours.
  • 🟢 Good News: IDF reports dismantling of a long underground tunnel and removal of an immediate threat in southern Lebanon.

  • ימי / מפרץ הפרסי: UKMTO הוציא אזהרה לאחר דיווח על התקפה על מכלית שנעה מזרחה לעבר מיצרי הורמוז. IRGC (TASS) מדווח על טביעת סופר־מכלית במפרץ הפרסי.
  • מרחב האווירי האיראני / הגנה אווירית: שוגר טיל נ

Situation report — last 6 hours

  • Northern border — Lebanon:
    • IDF 300th Brigade operating in the Security Zone, southern Lebanon, to remove threats to civilians.
    • IDF reports dismantled ~35m underground tunnel with two Hezbollah living quarters near Majdal Zoun; another tunnel also reported dismantled.
  • Gaza / casualties:
    • 70 bodies recovered from rubble; thousands still missing (Al Jazeera).
    • Mass funerals and families burying those trapped under rubble. Hamas reports 1,647 killed and 5,969 wounded since the Oct 2025 ceasefire (group statement).
  • Maritime / Gulf
    • UKMTO tanker-attack warning; IRGC reports supertanker sunk in Persian Gulf.
    • US Army tested/Launched an 18-drone swarm from an unmanned ground vehicle (defense report).
  • Diplomatic / strategic moves:
    • NATO canceled its planned 2027 leaders' summit and is reducing high-level meetings (statement).
    • Reports: Iran in close contact with Russia and China (diplomat comment).
    • Jordan detained an Israeli civilian who crossed by sea into Jordanian waters (IDF report).
    • Media report: NYT/Times of Israel claim Israeli operation kidnapped two Iranian generals and killed one searching for Ron Arad (news report).
  • Bottom line — threat trend: Escalating. Multiple coordinated actions across the Gulf, maritime routes, Bahrain, southern Lebanon and Gaza in the last several hours.
  • 🟢 Good News: IDF reports dismantling of a long underground tunnel containing Hezbollah living quarters in Majdal Zoun.

  • Threat trend

    • Regional escalation: multiple maritime attacks/sinkings, aerial/drone strikes, air-defense activity and cross-border operations indicate rising operational tempo across several fronts.
